segments.text: 1 The greatest violation of Conscience is the greatest sinne.
2 The greatest anguish of Conscience is the greatest punishment.

3 That uncertainety of Gods favour, which the Papists hold, and that uncertainety of Persevering in grace, which others teach, is cleane contrarie to that solid joy, and strong confidence, which proceedeth from a Conscience truly good.
4 The interpretation of the Scriptures, or a judgement to discerne Gods will for a mans selfe, in his owne Conscience, belongs to every man.
